name: Docker Build for Browser Mode

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "master", "beta", "release" ]
    paths:
      - 'Dockerfile.browser'
      - '.dockerignore'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'events/**'
      - 'src/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'yarn.lock'
  schedule:
    # Runs on 1st and 15th of each month at 2:00 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 2 1,15 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME: mqtt-explorer
  DOCKER_REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  DOCKER_REPOSITORY: thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer
  MQTT_BROKER_HOST: localhost
  MQTT_BROKER_PORT: 1883

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.DOCKER_REPOSITORY }}
          tags: |
            type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' }}
            type=raw,value=beta,enable=${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/beta' }}
            type=raw,value=release,enable=${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/release' }}
            type=sha,prefix={{branch}}-,enable=true

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile.browser
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64,linux/arm/v7
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          build-args: |
            MQTT_BROKER_HOST=${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_HOST }}
            MQTT_BROKER_PORT=${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_PORT }}

      - name: Image size report
        run: |
          echo "Image sizes:"
          echo "${{ steps.build.outputs.image-size }}"

      - name: Run vulnerability scan
        uses: anchore/scan-action@1638637db639e0ade3258b51db49a9a137574c3e
        with:
          image: ${{ steps.build.outputs.image }}
          fail-build: false
          output-format: json

      - name: Start Mosquitto MQTT broker
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name mosquitto \
            --network host \
            eclipse-mosquitto:2.0 \
            mosquitto -c /mosquitto-no-auth.conf

      - name: Wait for Mosquitto to start
        run: |
          sleep 5

      - name: Run UI tests against container
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name mqtt-explorer \
            --network host \
            ${{ steps.build.outputs.image }} \
            --mqtt-broker-host ${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_HOST }} \
            --mqtt-broker-port ${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_PORT }}

          sleep 10

          # Test basic functionality
          curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1
          curl -f http://localhost:8080/ || exit 1

          # Verify container is running
          docker ps | grep mqtt-explorer || exit 1

      - name: Run Cypress tests
        uses: cypress-io/github-action@v6
        with:
          project: .
          install: false
          start: npm run serve:browser
          wait-on: 'http://localhost:8080'
          spec: cypress/e2e/browser.cy.ts
          browser: chrome
          headed: false
          record: false
          parallel: false
          group: 'Browser Tests'

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          files: '**/test-results.xml'

      - name: Attest build provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v1
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        with:
          subject-name: ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.DOCKER_REPOSITORY }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
          predicate-type: https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1
          predicate-file: provenance.json
